bus empliciusююююююююююююю

Coloniensis racemamamara, leamamacificae et ac-

portium etroca lacutis anhedora. Reimpolator in id-

cada, a quo-datum omna optimumus et omna domum

perfectum, gamtem vectram, devotam et in Caobirdis

Paragrinolicis parthenorantam magnificari deper-

lenna, quadrigam epid component, in guen premium

etermus premarerunt et farmam lamporolans, guam

Aerodora nom postum, de in capite ilimae peralvenne.

Lint adqua in finam April Damietam eiguideam humi-

cilatem magnam olandarum, Cargitatum, oboeion

et audaciam, Sabracamid formidodi, Caridliamid caeni.

Unda was pbotatox eccobiumu hollamur et obde-

cramid in Carislo, quatemus dicub ex dlatuto latera-

nerid concicil inimilatoris eorum, qui aquad Damis-

labam deae et fuerunt, par caudram eccobidicam,

guam patriancha publica et nos coneram malaportior

Paragrinornus teplonot, furat et adion franotonea et

modimorans promodamim, non negligatis. Et ver-

condus letra prolatis estris in hac te non contra-

dicatis, sed diamurciatus volis imicriatoris caetis

ciliatis. Nam Paragrinos, quod Deud exaltam, homi-

ned honoras Lemonius. Scriptum aquad Damietam

in exaetationa sancta curid.

Vora Bapt. de acatuma varu sleads

Bewand. Bapt. S. Gier. oaspr. kolbadr. U.

welft weinig, houdt daardser soberder
